Name: Punta della Suina — gay naturist beach
Address: Gay naturist coves between Punta della Suina and Spiaggia degli Innamorati, Gallipoli, Puglia, Italy
Description: Looking for Gallipoli’s gay naturist beach? Head for the quieter coves beyond Punta della Suina rather than the main beach club. From the parking area, follow the paths through the pine wood and walk roughly ten minutes north toward Spiaggia degli Innamorati. Expect rocky shelves, small hidden inlets, clear water and a lively gay summer crowd. Bring water and shoes suitable for the rocks; services are limited once you leave the main beach. Naturism is practised informally in secluded sections, but this is not an officially designated nude beach.
Vibe_Tags: Gay Beach, Naturist, FKK, Outdoor, Rocky Beach, Summer
Opening_Notes: Outdoor coastal area; best visited in daylight during summer. Gay naturist stretch is separate from managed Punta della Suina lido.
